testcase.name: Scenario: Activate a document from the tab-strip window list: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-3sxHck/checkout/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:177:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Activate a document from the tab-strip window list ✔ Given a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the part is active ✔ And document tabs are visible ✔ When the user opens the document list at the end of the tab strip ✔ Then the list contains the open part and drawing ✔ And the active part is marked in the list ✔ And the menu offers Arrange, Horizontal Tile, Vertical Tile and Restore All ✔ And the menu offers separate Close Tabs and Close All items ✔ When the user selects the drawing from the list ✔ Then the drawing becomes active ✔ And its sheet and drawing browser are displayed ✔ And the part remains open
